name: Late Night History TV

banned_phrases: to understand how we get there

short.note: 40-60 s vertical: one striking historical mystery or fact, calm but intriguing, last line loops into the first and teases the full video

long.note: 2.5-3 h sleep documentary (measured ~125 wpm with gentle pauses: 18,700-22,400 words) in 15-25 chapters; one era/mystery told as a calm, accurate story, steady wonder, no shock cliffhangers

publish.slots_note: 01:00 UTC = 9 pm EDT / 8 pm EST (East Coast bedtime wave, also late night UK); 04:00 UTC = 9 pm PDT / midnight EDT (West Coast). Times are UTC, so local times shift 1 h when US DST ends (Nov 1).

fair_use_note: Narrated historical documentary for relaxation and learning. Images are historical artworks, photographs and maps from Wikimedia Commons; each keeps its own licence (see the credits link). Narration voice is AI-generated.
image_style: richly detailed semi-realistic digital oil painting, historical illustration, warm candlelit palette, soft painterly brushwork, atmospheric depth, no text, no watermark
